arxiv-1808-05754.title: Auto-Classification of Retinal Diseases in the Limit of Sparse Data Using a Two-Streams Machine Learning Model
arxiv-1808-05754.creator: C.-H. Huck Yang*, Fangyu Liu*, Jia-Hong Huang*, Meng Tian, Hiromasa Morikawa, I-Hung Lin M.D, Yi Chieh Liu, Hao-Hsiang Yang, Jesper Tegnèr
arxiv-1808-05754.description: Abstract Automatic clinical diagnosis of retinal diseases has emerged as a promising approach to facilitate discovery in areas with limited access to specialists. Based on the fact that fundus structure and vascular disorders are the main characteristics of retinal diseases, we propose a novel visual-assisted diagnosis hybrid model mixing the support vector machine (SVM) and deep neural networks (DNNs).

arxiv-2102-07066.title: Acoustic response of turbulent cavity flow using resolvent analysis
arxiv-2102-07066.creator: Qiong Liu \corresp and Datta Gaitonde
arxiv-2102-07066.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Qiong Liu \corresp and Datta Gaitonde. Fluid-acoustic interactions are important in a variety of applications, and typically result in adverse effects. We analyze the influence of Mach number on such interactions and their input-output characteristics by combining resolvent analysis with Doak’s momentum potential theory. The specific problem selected is the flow over an open cavity of L / D = 6 L/D=6 at R ​ e = 10,000 Re=10,000 and M ∞ = 0.6 M_{\infty}=0.6 and 1.4 1.4 , respectively.

arxiv-2202-04796.title: The Transfer Performance of Economic Models Thanks: We thank Jiafeng Chen, Stefano DellaVigna, Nic Fishman, Matthew Gentzkow, Andrei Iakovlev, Michael Jordan, Brandon Kaplowitz, Paulo Natenzon, Kyohei Okumura, Pietro Ortoleva, Michael Ostrovsky, Ashesh Rambachan, Bas Sanders, Jesse Shapiro, Eisho Ta
arxiv-2202-04796.creator: Isaiah Andrews §, Drew Fudenberg ‡, Lihua Lei #, Annie Liang †, Chaofeng Wu ∗
arxiv-2202-04796.description: Abstract . Economists often use models estimated on data from a particular domain to make predictions in another. We provide a tractable formulation for this “out-of-domain” prediction problem and define the transfer error of a model based on its performance in a new domain.

arxiv-2211-04187.title: Aspects of AdS flux vacua with integer conformal dimensions
arxiv-2211-04187.creator: Fien Apers
arxiv-2211-04187.description: Abstract The DGKT vacua are a class of AdS 4 flux vacua showing full moduli stabilization, parametric control, and a parametric separation of scales. The particular masses of the moduli remarkably give rise to integer conformal dimensions in the light spectrum of the would-be holographic duals.

arxiv-2211-13626.title: Bidding Graph Games with Partially-Observable Budgets Thanks: This research was supported in part by ISF grant no. 1679/21, by the ERC CoG 863818 (ForM-SMArt), and the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Grant Agreement No. 665385.
arxiv-2211-13626.creator: Guy Avni, Ismäel Jecker, Đorđe Žikelić
arxiv-2211-13626.description: Abstract Two-player zero-sum graph games are a central model, which proceeds as follows. A token is placed on a vertex of a graph, and the two players move it to produce an infinite play , which determines the winner or payoff of the game. Traditionally, the players alternate turns in moving the token.

arxiv-2311-13003.title: Critical exponent of binary words with few distinct palindromes
arxiv-2311-13003.creator: L​’ubomíra Dvořáková, Pascal Ochem, Daniela Opočenská
arxiv-2311-13003.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by L​’ubomíra Dvořáková, Pascal Ochem, Daniela Opočenská. We study infinite binary words that contain few distinct palindromes. In particular, we classify such words according to their critical exponents. This extends results by Fici and Zamboni [TCS 2013]. Interestingly, the words with 18 and 20 palindromes happen to be morphic images of the fixed point of the morphism 0 ↦ 01 \texttt{0}\mapsto\texttt{01} , 1 ↦ 21 \texttt{1}\mapsto\texttt{21} , 2 ↦ 0 \texttt{2}\mapsto\texttt{0} .

arxiv-2406-17761.title: CaLMQA: Exploring culturally specific long-form question answering across 23 languages
arxiv-2406-17761.creator: Shane Arora Marzena Karpinska Hung-Ting Chen, Ipsita Bhattacharjee Mohit Iyyer Eunsol Choi, The University of Texas at Austin, New York University, University of Massachusetts Amherst shane.arora@utexas.edu {hung-ting.chen, eunsol}@nyu.edu
arxiv-2406-17761.description: Abstract Despite rising global usage of large language models (LLMs), their ability to generate long-form answers to culturally specific questions remains unexplored in many languages. To fill this gap, we perform the first study of textual multilingual long-form QA by creating CaLMQA , a dataset of 51.7K culturally specific questions across 23 different languages.

arxiv-2412-02913.title: On the boundedness of Gross’ solution to the planar Skorokhod embedding problem
arxiv-2412-02913.creator: Maher Boudabra, Dhaker Kroumi, Boubaker Smii
arxiv-2412-02913.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Maher Boudabra, Dhaker Kroumi, Boubaker Smii. In this work, we investigate the problem of the boundedness of the Gross’ solutions of the planar Skorokhod embedding problem, where we show that the solution is bounded under some mild conditions on the underlying probability distribution. Keywords and phrases : Planar Brownian motion, Skorokhod embedding problem Mathematics Subject Classification (2010) : 1 Introduction In 2019 , the author R.

arxiv-2503-22813.title: Many facets of cohomology
arxiv-2503-22813.creator: Kaibo Hu
arxiv-2503-22813.description: Abstract . Complexes and cohomology, traditionally central to topology, have emerged as fundamental tools across applied mathematics and the sciences. This survey explores their roles in diverse areas, from partial differential equations and continuum mechanics to reformulations of the Einstein equations and network theory.

arxiv-2512-00994.title: Newsvendor Decisions under Stochastic and Strategic Uncertainties: Theory and Experimental Evidence
arxiv-2512-00994.creator: Hang Wu, Qin Wu, Yue Liu, Mengmeng Shi
arxiv-2512-00994.description: Abstract The rapid expansion of digital commerce platforms has amplified the strategic importance of coordinated pricing and inventory management decisions among competing retailers. Motivated by practices on leading e-commerce platforms, we analyze a sequential duopolistic newsvendor game where retailers first publicly set prices and subsequently make private inventory decisions under demand uncertainty.

arxiv-2601-03066.title: Do LLMs Encode Functional Importance of Reasoning Tokens ?
arxiv-2601-03066.creator: Janvijay Singh, Dilek Hakkani-Tür
arxiv-2601-03066.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Janvijay Singh, Dilek Hakkani-Tür. Large language models solve complex tasks by generating long reasoning chains, achieving higher accuracy at the cost of increased computational cost and reduced ability to isolate functionally relevant reasoning. Prior work on compact reasoning shortens such chains through probabilistic sampling, heuristics, or supervision from frontier models, but offers limited insight into whether models internally encode token-level functional importance for answer generation.

pmc-10597294.title: Pressure, bullying and low social support predict depressive symptoms and self-directed violence
pmc-10597294.creator: T Stea, T Bonsaksen, P Smith, A L Kleppang, A M Steigen, M Leonhardt, L Lien, M V Vettore
pmc-10597294.description: BackgroundMore in-depth evidence about the complex relationships between risk and protective factors and mental health among adolescents has been warranted. Thus, the aim of the study was to examine the direct and indirect effects of experiencing pressure, bullying, and low social support on depressive symptoms and self-directed violence in adolescence.

pmc-11441862.title: Poor emotional well-being and energy are associated with mortality in patients with advanced liver failure
pmc-11441862.creator: Shruti Shapuram, Nikita Gunnala, Hanisha Guta Artham, Shantan Venishetty, Sarika Kolli, Sumana Kolar, Anveshi Satyavadhi, Santhosh Reddy Satti, Mithun Sharma, Manasa Alla, Sowmya Iyengar, Padaki Nagaraja Rao, Duvvur Nageshwar Reddy, Anand V. Kulkarni
pmc-11441862.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). romes associated with poor outcomes. 1 Several studies have reported that the health-related quality of life (HRQOL) of patients with DC is poorer compared to the general population and is dependent on the severity of liver disease.2,3 To date, only 1 study has reported that patients with ACLF (identified by the European Association for the Study of Liver-Consortium for Chronic Liver Failure [EASL-CLIF] criteria) have poorer QOL compared to patients with DC.

pmc-11453340.title: 7006 Transient Adrenal Suppression in Pediatric Patients following Propofol Infusion: A Case Report
pmc-11453340.creator: Mostafa Salama, Aida Nadim
pmc-11453340.description: Disclosure: M. Salama: None. A.N. Lteif: None. Introduction: Intravenous propofol is widely employed for procedural sedation, monitored anesthesia care, and induction of general anesthesia. It can be administered as a bolus or an infusion. While extensively used, reports in adults and animal studies suggest potential implications of propofol on adrenal steroidogenesis.

pmc-11519385.title: Fabry Disease in a Female: A Unique Case Highlighting the Variability in Clinical Presentation
pmc-11519385.creator: Arshiya Gupta, Sumedh R Luthra, Shivansh Luthra
pmc-11519385.description: Fabry disease is a rare X-linked lysosomal storage disorder caused by mutations in the GLA gene, leading to deficient activity of the enzyme alpha-galactosidase A. This enzyme deficiency results in the accumulation of globotriaosylceramide (Gb3) in various tissues, causing multi-systemic manifestations.

pmc-12644653.title: DSSCC net enhanced skin cancer classification using SMOTE Tomek and optimized convolutional neural network
pmc-12644653.creator: Muhammad Aqib Javaid, Muhammad Suleman Shahzad, Hafiz Muhammad Faisal Shehzad, Samreen Razzaq, Shujaat Ali, Dilawar Shah, Muhammad Tahir
pmc-12644653.description: Skin cancer remains a major global health concern where early detection can significantly improve treatment outcomes. Traditional methods rely on expert evaluation, which can be prone to errors. DSSCC-Net, a deep CNN model integrated with SMOTE-Tomek oversampling, improves classification accuracy and effectively handles class imbalance in dermoscopic datasets.

pmc-12752648.title: Identification of TPRA1 as a Novel Receptor and Predictive Biomarker for Oncolytic Virus M1
pmc-12752648.creator: Linyi Hu, Guigen Zhang, Yuan Lin, Shiming Yi, Jingyu Yang, Xueying Lin, Deli Song, Zhiheng Liu, Jiayu Zhang, Ying Zeng, Shanyu Huang, Zhen Fan, Jifu Zhang, Ying Liu, Cheng Hu, Wenbo Zhu, Wei Yin, Jun Hu, Guangmei Yan, Jing Cai, Jiankai Liang
pmc-12752648.description: Viral receptors are essential host factors that determine the tropism of oncolytic viruses, and contribute to their selective targeting of cancer cells. In this study, a membrane protein‐targeted CRISPR‐Cas9 screen is conducted and identify transmembrane protein adipocyte‐associated 1 (TPRA1) as a novel receptor for oncolytic virus M1(OVM), a promising oncolytic virus currently under clinical investigation.

pmc-13317417.title: Assessment of correlation between effluent fluid ionized calcium and post-filter ionized calcium in critically ill patients undergoing regional citrate anticoagulation in continuous renal replacement therapy (RCA-CRRT)
pmc-13317417.creator: Niroj Mali, Saroj Mali, Mingjin Dai, Lingxi Zhang, Fang Wang, Yingying Yang, Xiankun Sun, Hongxia Zou, Ling Zhang, Ping Fu

pmc-13374344.title: Diagnostic performance of systemic inflammatory and nutritional indices and their association with clinicopathological features in endometrial cancer: a retrospective study
pmc-13374344.creator: Şule Gül Aydın, Şahin Yüksek, Mehmet Güzel, Mehmet Çopuroğlu, Hasan Can Toyganözü
pmc-13374344.description: BackgroundSystemic inflammatory and nutritional indices derived from routine blood tests have been widely investigated as prognostic markers; however, their diagnostic value in differentiating benign endometrial disease from endometrial cancer (EC) remains insufficiently defined. This study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic performance of inflammatory and nutritional indices and to explore their associations with clinicopathological features in EC.

pmc-13588622.title: Defective neuronal differentiation in Lowe syndrome is associated with mitochondrial dysfunction and impaired cilia-related Sonic Hedgehog signaling
pmc-13588622.creator: Grzegorz Walkiewicz, Siyu Chen, Chienhui Lo, Jingyu Zhao, Zhiquan Liu, Biao Wang, Qing Wang, Tia J Kowal, Benjamin Lawson, Yang Sun, Xiaorong Liu, Yamini Dalal, Xiaorong Liu, Anonymous, Grzegorz Walkiewicz, Siyu Chen, Chienhui Lo, Jingyu Zhao, Zhiquan Liu, Biao Wang, Qing Wang, Tia J Kowal, Benjamin
pmc-13588622.description: Human brain development requires tight coordination of metabolic and signaling pathways. Lowe syndrome (LS) is a recessive X-linked disorder characterized by proximal tubular renal disease, congenital cataracts, glaucoma, and neurodevelopmental delays. While LS results from mutations in the OCRL gene, which encodes an inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase, the cellular mechanisms driving neuronal dysfunction remain poorly understood.
